scope: Document-level failure, retry, and fresh ASCII/Binary DXF readback controls for the two-root AC1024 dynamic graph. This does not establish native dynamic-block semantics or promote a support claim.

implementation.result: Adds ASCII and Binary whole-document exports from the local source. For each of the six selected dynamic parameter dependencies, a missing constraint-group action edge and a wrong dependency owner must refuse publication. Each encoding also injects a late source mutation after OBJECTS staging. Every failure preserves the destination sentinel and leaves source callback qualification state unchanged; the same exporter then retries successfully and qualifies all 490 callbacks.

dxfOriginReplay.source: AC1024 DXF freshly read from the existing local DWG input; no fixture was added
dxfOriginReplay.sourceBinding: Parse-time typed XRECORD and raw dynamic/associative carrier snapshots are bounded and matched by import generation, version, identity, and full model/raw fields.
dxfOriginReplay.stagedOutputProof: The OBJECTS inspector compares the exact selected dynamic and associative raw group streams against the source snapshots, applying only the writer handle remap; every expected identity must occur exactly once.
failureRetryControls: late dynamic model mutation after OBJECTS staging refuses output and preserves the destination sentinel
late XRECORD 1071 mutation refuses output and preserves the destination sentinel
restoring each source model allows the same exporter to retry successfully
dxfOriginReplay.freshReadback: Both encodings retain the complete typed/raw dynamic and associative carrier counts and preserve every checked identity, class, owner, node, edge, dependency field, and role.
dxfOriginReplay.qualificationLimit: Adapter-level same-version replay only; native dynamic-block evaluation and EvalExpr parentId semantics remain unqualified.

verified: Exact two-root EvaluationGraph identity set, owner, values, ordered nodes, and edges
Exact 65-object dynamic identity set, unique handles, record kinds, owners, EvalExpr parse state and node IDs
All three constraint groups, owner handles, body/action parse state, counts and ordered action references
All six dependency fields and flags, group owners, parameter/body target roles and dependency-body names
freshReadback.known_projection_boundary: EvalExpr parentId is not emitted by the current admitted DXF projection. For source handle 0x1111 (BLOCKLINEARGRIP), the source sentinel 0xFFFFFFFF reads back as 0. The roundtrip test deliberately does not equate this parser/default state; native or authoritative field evidence must decide whether it is semantics-neutral or whether the projection needs another field.

build.result: PASS with the configured warning-as-error build

newSelector.result: PASS for DWG-origin and DXF-origin paths in both encodings. The DXF-origin path proves source mutation refusal, destination rollback, corrected retry, exact staged typed/raw dynamic and associative bodies, and fresh readback. Expected graph rejection diagnostics are emitted for deliberately invalid edge/owner controls. Generated outputs are removed by the test.

remaining: Independent native dynamic-block semantics for both roots, visibility, parameter/action behavior, and reachable geometry
Resolve the EvalExpr parentId DXF-projection boundary with authoritative field or independent semantic evidence
